sections.heading: C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Bicycles and Commercial Motor Vehicles
sections.markdown:
## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Bicycles and Commercial Motor Vehicles

FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A01
Bikes own vehicle rights off limited ways, lane exits for safety, and narrow-lane ownership [A01].
Why it matters: group bike-status; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A01
Passing clears three feet slowed, treating two-lane riders as slow vehicles [A01].
Why it matters: group passing-bikes; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R03 | anchor: A01
Crossings read riders straight absent signals, yield fully, and turn behind them [A01].
Why it matters: group intersections; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F03 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R04 | anchor: A01
Tailgating, high beams, dooring, and horn blasts all threaten riders [A01].
Why it matters: group rider-safety; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F04 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R05 | anchor: A01
Slow riders hug lanes or right edges while lefts, passes, hazards, and narrows free full lanes [A01].
Why it matters: group rider-lanes; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec10-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0089]

FACT_ID: sec10-R06 | anchor: A02
Hitching bans outright while sidewalks grant walker rights with yields and audible passes [A02].
Why it matters: group sidewalk; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F06 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-R07 | anchor: A02
Night kit pairs 500-foot white fronts with 600-foot red rears, brakes stop 25 feet from 10 MPH, and under-16 heads helmet [A02].
Why it matters: group bike-gear; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec10-F07 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-R08 | anchor: A02
Young light riders carrier up attended, pairs cap doubles off paths, ears stay half open, and sobriety rules [A02].
Why it matters: group rider-rules; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F08, sec10-F09 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-R09 | anchor: A02
No Zones blind every side of big rigs despite mirror banks [A02].
Why it matters: group no-zone; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F11 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0090]

FACT_ID: sec10-R10 | anchor: A02
Avoid tailgating commercial motor vehicles, leave room and keep left in your lane for visibility when stopped behind one on an upgrade in case it drifts backward on startup, and keep high beams off when following one at night [A02].
Why it matters: group cmv; difficulty low; prereq sec10-R09; confusables sec10-F12 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-fl-e:florida-department-of-highway-safety-and:handbook:pdf-0090]

corpus_stability.reason: The Official Florida Driver License Handbook is a dated revision (rev. 08/2023) reissued at most annually, so sharing-the-road rules change at most once per year.
